certificates-expiring.title: Certificates expiring
certificates-expiring.question: Which certificates expire soon, and how many styles do they cover?
certificates-expiring.definition: Every valid certificate whose last valid day is from today to the end of the period, soonest first. Days left is 0 on the last valid day.

overdue-receivables.title: Overdue from customers
overdue-receivables.question: Which customers owe us money past the due date?
overdue-receivables.definition: Every customer with an invoice past its due date, per company and currency, most overdue first. Open = what is still to be paid; overdue = the part past its due date; credit notes and payments are taken off.
overdue-receivables.sources: Issued invoices, credit notes and payments with their due dates

stock-value.title: Stock value
stock-value.question: What are our stock and work in progress worth at cost?
stock-value.definition: Every stock line (item, colour, lot) of each site with stock now, and each open work order’s cost booked so far (WIP), summed per site and category. A line not fully valued has moves the valuation could not price yet (Finance › Reports says which).
stock-value.sources: Stock moves and their valuation, work order cost entries

shortages.title: Shortages
shortages.question: What material is short for our work orders?
shortages.definition: Each material a work order still needs that the latest plan cannot cover in time: Not enough (no stock or order covers it) or Delayed (an order covers it but arrives after it is needed). Released or started work orders by default.
shortages.sources: The latest planning run of each site, work orders, stock and purchase orders

daily.title: Daily production
daily.question: What did each line make on the last working day?
daily.definition: One site and one day (the first site you see unless you pick one). Good = garments through the line’s last operation; scrap and rework at any of its operations. Efficiency = earned standard minutes ÷ (people × the line’s working minutes), hidden for a line of fewer than 5 people.
daily.sources: Floor scans, work orders, line capacity and the site calendar

scrap-by-reason.title: Scrap by reason
scrap-by-reason.question: Why do we scrap garments, and how many?
scrap-by-reason.definition: Garments reported as scrap (or rework) at any operation in the period, per reason code, most garments first. Value at cost = the material of the scrapped pieces at its stock value. The list reads at most 500 reports per run.
scrap-by-reason.sources: Floor scrap and rework scans, rework orders and the materials they used

wip-by-stage.title: WIP by stage
wip-by-stage.question: How much work is in progress at each stage?
wip-by-stage.definition: Every work order in draft, released, in progress or on hold. Garments = ordered in its cells; cut, sewn and finished = garments through those steps so far (none for a draft). Late = due date before today.
wip-by-stage.sources: Work orders, their cells and the floor scans

receipts-due.title: Receipts due
receipts-due.question: Which deliveries are due from suppliers, and which are late?
receipts-due.definition: Each line of a sent, confirmed, partly received or changed purchase order with goods still to come. Expected = the date the supplier confirmed, else the date we asked; late = expected before today; this week = today to Sunday.
receipts-due.sources: Purchase orders, their lines and goods receipts

open-ncrs.title: Open nonconformances
open-ncrs.question: Which nonconformances are still open, and how old are they?
open-ncrs.definition: Every nonconformance open, contained or decided, newest first. Age counts whole days since it was found; containment overdue = the containment (or an open action) is due before now. Decisions waiting = dispositions that wait for an approval.

late-orders.title: Late orders
late-orders.question: Which orders are late against their promise date?
late-orders.definition: Orders confirmed, in production, ready to ship or partly shipped whose promise date is before today. Days late counts from the promise date to today.

margin-by-order.title: Margin by order
margin-by-order.question: What margin do we make on each order?
margin-by-order.definition: Every order (cancelled ones left out) with an order date in the period. Margin quoted = net value less the quoted cost; margin now = net value less the estimate now (work orders done at their actual cost, the rest at the larger of plan and actual); margin so far = the cost booked until today. A blank margin: no cost is known yet.
margin-by-order.sources: Sales orders, their quotes, work orders and cost entries

open-orders.title: Open orders
open-orders.question: Which orders are open, and when are they promised?
open-orders.definition: Every order confirmed, in production, ready to ship or partly shipped, newest first. Days late counts from the promise date to today.

orders-in.title: Orders in
orders-in.question: Which orders came in, and for how much?
orders-in.definition: Every order with an order date in the period, newest first; cancelled orders are left out. The net value is before VAT.

shipments-on-time.title: Shipped on time
shipments-on-time.question: Which shipments left on time against the order’s promise date?
shipments-on-time.definition: Every shipment shipped or delivered with a ship date in the period (site days). On time: shipped on or before the order’s promise date; an order without a promise date is said apart and not counted either way.

orders.inThisWeek.label: Orders in this week
orders.inThisWeek.definition: The net value of the sales orders taken this week.
orders.inThisWeek.formula: Sum of the net amount (before VAT) of every order with an order date this week, cancelled orders left out.
orders.inThisWeek.period: This week, Monday to today; the line shows the last 8 weeks.

orders.late.label: Late orders
orders.late.definition: Open orders whose promise date has passed.
orders.late.formula: Count of orders confirmed, in production, ready or partly shipped with a promise date before today.

orders.promisedThisWeek.label: Promised this week
orders.promisedThisWeek.definition: Open orders promised to the customer for this week.
orders.promisedThisWeek.formula: Count of open orders with a promise date from Monday to Sunday of this week.

orders.shippedOnTime.label: Shipped on time
orders.shippedOnTime.definition: The share of shipments that left on or before the order’s promise date.
orders.shippedOnTime.formula: Shipments shipped in the last 4 weeks that left on or before their order’s promise date, divided by every shipment shipped in those weeks.
orders.shippedOnTime.period: The last 4 weeks; the line shows each of the last 8 weeks.

orders.marginThisMonth.label: Margin this month
orders.marginThisMonth.definition: The average margin of the orders taken this month, from the estimate now.
orders.marginThisMonth.formula: Average estimate margin % of the orders with an order date this month (orders without a known cost left out).
orders.marginThisMonth.sources: Sales orders, their work orders and cost entries
orders.marginThisMonth.period: This month, from the 1st to today.

workorders.late.label: Work orders late
workorders.late.definition: Open work orders past their due date.
workorders.late.formula: Count of work orders in draft, released, in progress or on hold with a due date before today.

planning.shortages.label: Short of material
planning.shortages.definition: Released work orders that miss a material they need.
planning.shortages.formula: Count of released or started work orders with at least one material short or arriving after it is needed, in the latest plan.
planning.shortages.sources: The latest planning run, work orders and purchase orders
planning.shortages.period: Now, as of the latest planning run.

planning.loadNextWeek.label: Load next week
planning.loadNextWeek.definition: The booked work of next week against the capacity of the lines and work centres.
planning.loadNextWeek.formula: Booked standard minutes of next week divided by the available minutes (people × working minutes × efficiency) of every line and work centre.
planning.loadNextWeek.sources: The planning board, line capacity and the site calendars

production.goodLastDay.label: Good garments, last working day
production.goodLastDay.definition: Garments that came out of the lines and work centres on the last working day.
production.goodLastDay.formula: Good garments through each line’s last operation, summed over the lines and work centres of your sites.
production.goodLastDay.sources: Floor scans, work orders and the site calendars
production.goodLastDay.period: The last working day of each site’s calendar.

purchasing.notConfirmed.label: Not confirmed after 2 days
purchasing.notConfirmed.definition: Purchase orders sent more than 48 hours ago that the supplier has not confirmed.
purchasing.notConfirmed.formula: Count of purchase orders in Sent with a send time more than 48 hours ago.

purchasing.lateDeliveries.label: Deliveries late
purchasing.lateDeliveries.definition: Purchase orders with goods still to come after the date the supplier confirmed (or we asked).
purchasing.lateDeliveries.formula: Count of open purchase orders with a line whose expected date (confirmed, else asked) is before today and is not all received.

purchasing.dueThisWeek.label: Deliveries due this week
purchasing.dueThisWeek.definition: Purchase orders with goods expected from today to Sunday.
purchasing.dueThisWeek.formula: Count of open purchase orders with a line expected this week and not all received.

finance.overdue.label: Overdue from customers
finance.overdue.definition: What customers owe us past the due date.
finance.overdue.formula: Sum of the open amounts of issued invoices whose due date has passed, credit notes and payments taken off.
finance.overdue.sources: Invoices, payments and their due dates

finance.sdiRefused.label: Refused by SDI
finance.sdiRefused.definition: Invoices the tax authority’s exchange (SDI) refused: they must be corrected and sent again.

finance.invoicedThisWeek.label: Invoiced this week
finance.invoicedThisWeek.definition: The net value invoiced this week.
finance.invoicedThisWeek.formula: Sum of the net totals of the invoices issued this week, credit notes taken off.
finance.invoicedThisWeek.period: This week, Monday to today; the line shows the last 8 weeks.

finance.stockValue.label: Stock value
finance.stockValue.definition: What the stock and the work in progress are worth at cost.
finance.stockValue.formula: Sum of the value of every stock move up to now (leather, materials, trims, packaging, finished goods) plus the cost entries of the work in progress.
finance.stockValue.sources: Stock moves and their valuation, work order cost entries

quality.lotsOnHold.label: Lots on hold
quality.lotsOnHold.definition: Received lots that may not be used yet: in quarantine or blocked.
quality.lotsOnHold.formula: Count of lots in Quarantine or Blocked.

quality.ncrOverdue.label: Containment overdue
quality.ncrOverdue.definition: Open nonconformances whose containment is past its due date.
quality.ncrOverdue.formula: Count of nonconformances still open with the containment (or an open action) due before now.

quality.ncrOpen.label: Open nonconformances
quality.ncrOpen.formula: Count of nonconformances open, contained or decided.

compliance.certificatesExpiring.label: Certificates expiring in 90 days
compliance.certificatesExpiring.definition: Valid certificates that end in the next 90 days.
compliance.certificatesExpiring.formula: Count of certificates in Valid whose last valid day is from today to 90 days from now.
